evidence.quote: This study was conducted to systematically compare the susceptibility of cotton rats and BALB/c mice to RSV infection in the respiratory system and CNS, and to examine the associated pathological changes.
The experimental unit was defined as a single animal. For both BALB/c mice and cotton rats, 6 animals per group (RSV-infected/PBS control).
qRT–PCR was performed on a CFX96 Touch™ Real–Time PCR Detection System (Bio-Rad Laboratories, Hercules, CA, USA) using the HiScript II One Step qRT–PCR Probe Kit.
